i.norm: Verifies that replacing a CharSequence consisting entirely of null characters produces a string of the same null characters, and that the default escape character is '$'. CharBuffer.allocate('$') allocates a buffer of capacity 36 (the ASCII value of '$'), pre-filled with '�'. The replace() call converts that buffer to its string form without any variable substitution (no '${...}' patterns), so the result is a 36-character string of null characters.
'$' has ASCII value 36, so this allocates a 36-element buffer of '�'
The 36 null characters in the buffer are preserved as-is (no substitution occurs)
